method: Labelled independently from prims.pkl (area upper) and PNG renders only. I did not read the evidence inventory or other labellers' files; I did read results/map_elevations.json, which the task names. Steps: one render of the whole part (grid 1, inserts); 11 tiles of about 6 x 6.5 m (grid 0.5, inserts, text); then geometry queries of every wall line (WALL/COL plus WIN, WALL-GL, D-JAMB, DOOR, I-DOOR, FLOOR, TREE, FUR, A_Grill). A script then listed every gap between collinear wall-face segments (0.15-6 m), and I reviewed each gap. Swing arcs over 0.3 m radius were fitted to find every door and casement leaf (layer-0 arcs are all pebbles or furniture). Zoom renders of the courts, the strip, the dressing area and the staff block followed, and final renders with markers at each opening and each end checked the result. Ends are at the wall-end faces (frames inside the opening), with cladding (D-JAMB outline) counted as part of the wall. a/b lie on the middle of the wall band: x 112.0946 and 106.2946 for the 0.25 m suite walls, y 23.2338 for the north facade, y 18.0335 for the staff south facade, x 113.4696 for the screen wall, and wall centres for 0.10 m walls. Widths are |b-a|. Decision rules: one opening per wall gap (mullions do not split it); passage mouths and alcove mouths are optional; screened or ambiguous gaps are optional; hinged glazed leaves on the north facade are windows with eitherKind; shower screens and A_Grill grille screens are glassWalls.
